calculation_steps: Expand the retarded Schur complement (K-m omega^2-i omega D)^-1 at omega=0; the coefficient of -i omega is C K^-1 D K^-1 C^T.
For diagonal D in K's orthonormal eigenbasis, scalar drag gamma=sum_j a_j d_j, a_j=||C v_j||^2/(2 kappa_j^2).
Infer m_eff=kappa_j/(2 pi f_j)^2 from every archived mode in meV, Angstrom, ps; all 14 agree within 1e-10 relative.
Use high-Q power-spectrum FWHM Delta_f_j approximately d_j/(2 pi m_eff); pair 5/6 and 8/9 to obtain 16 A transfer coefficients 2.7634530847e-4 and 1.8676114422e-5.
Differentiate gamma(P)=2 pi m_eff [a_L(P) Delta_f_L(P)+a_H(P) Delta_f_H(P)] to expose the unmeasured linewidth derivatives.
Replay archived ±2.5 MPa pair-weight slopes and compare their sum with the prior pressure audit at cutoffs 14,16,18 A.

result.exact_expression: gamma_scalar=sum_j a_j d_j; gamma_prime=sum_j(a_j_prime d_j+a_j d_j_prime)
result.approximation: 16 A high-Q pair transfer [2.7634530847e-4,1.8676114422e-5] meV ps Angstrom^-2 per atom per THz FWHM; equal constant width log slope +8.0605246e-4 MPa^-1
result.units: per upper atom, pressure MPa; positive compression offset
result.precision_and_error: archival floating precision; cutoff/finite-difference sensitivity only, no experimental uncertainty
result.scope: conventional model with diagonal weak Markovian loss; not measured kinetic friction or UD source
result.physical_interpretation: material linewidth measurements are needed; high pair can dominate if over 14.797 times broader

verification.actual_result: PASS mode sums, mass consistency, three cutoff pressure decomposition

counterexamples_and_failures: D=0 in the finite closed harmonic carrier gives zero Ohmic drag despite nonzero static softening.
If D mixes the two symmetry-equivalent E copies, diagonal linewidths are insufficient; off-diagonal self-energy alters gamma.
A common width log slope -8.06052e-4 MPa^-1 cancels conditional gamma slope locally, so load independence is not unique to the port.
limitations: No measured phonon linewidth, self-energy, contact geometry or force trace.
Illustrative KC-plus-plate Hessian and tensile reference are conventional model assumptions, not UD source calibration.
Power-peak FWHM to d_j requires weak damping and separation of dissipative linewidth from instrumental and finite-time broadening.
The low-frequency gamma of a moving coordinate is not itself a coefficient of friction or sliding force.
next_discriminant: Measure pressure-resolved complex response and off-diagonal loss for active E pairs, independently calibrate additive UD C and conventional force estimator, then test held-out signed paired-angle forces.
